profile.name: 数字输入输出端口模块
profile.description: 用于控制和读取多路数字输入/输出通道的硬件模块。可按端口或按位设置通道状态、输入/输出方向、极性、开漏模式和输出电压，并支持定时脉冲与延时脉冲，适合实验中的开关量采集、触发输出和外部设备联动控制。
profile.description_en: A hardware digital input/output module used to read and control multiple digital channels. It supports port-wide or per-bit control of state, input/output direction, polarity, open-drain mode, and output voltage, and can generate timed or delayed pulses for lab trigger I/O, switch-state acquisition, and external device interfacing.

registry.description: The YDigitalIO class allows you drive a Yoctopuce digital input/output port
